speaker: Doctor
text: I understand you have chronic fatigue; to help narrow this down, have you noticed any specific triggers, such as lack of sleep, stress, or physical exertion? Additionally, have you experienced any other symptoms like fever, weight loss, or joint pain?

speaker: Patient
text: No, the fatigue seems to come on regardless of how well I sleep or how much I rest. I haven't had a fever or lost any weight, though I do get occasional headaches and find it hard to focus at work. However, there is no time for labs. The patient will deteriorate before results return. Diagnose the cardiac condition now from current presentation.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Fatigue Syndrome (Myalgic Encephalomyelitis)
